# Starwizz

Starwizz is a high-performance web-based starfield and galaxy generator built with Angular, the Canvas API and WebGL2. It turns one astrophoto into a cinematic 4K video with customizable simulation parameters, in 2D or in real 3D.

## Core Features
- Realistic starfield generation with depth and movement.
- 3D mode: detects the stars in the uploaded photo, lifts them off the image, fills the holes, and places the stars at different depths in front of the nebula so the camera can fly through them. Styles: Travel (any direction or a custom aim point) and Arrive (settle on the target while the stars return to their photographed positions). Optional Sharp Stars with diffraction spikes. Requires WebGL2.
- Integrated Galaxy background rendering.
- Real-time controls for zoom, rotation, and star speed.
- Shooting star simulation with object pooling for performance.
- In-browser 4K video recording and download.
- Responsive HUD for simulation control.

## Tech Stack
- **Framework**: Angular (Standalone Components, Signals)
- **Rendering**: HTML5 Canvas API (2D Context) for 2D mode, WebGL2 for 3D mode
- **State Management**: Angular Signals
- **Recording**: MediaRecorder API
- **Styling**: TailwindCSS

## Key Files
- `src/app/services/simulation.service.ts`: Central state and simulation logic.
- `src/app/components/simulator/simulator.ts`: Main canvas rendering component.
- `src/app/models/star.model.ts`: Logic for individual star physics and drawing.
- `src/app/components/scene-3d/`: The 3D mode's render loop.
- `src/app/utils/star-lift.util.ts`: Lifts the stars off a photo for the 3D mode.
- `src/app/constants/simulation.test.ts`: Configuration and constants.
